document.text: LEAD SUPPLY AGREEMENT between LeadCo LLC (Vendor) and Example Solar Co (Client). 3. Vendor warrants every lead gave prior express written consent naming Example Solar Co, and supplies a TrustedForm certificate Client may claim. 4. On request Vendor sends consent records within 5 business days and keeps them 5 years. 5. Vendor passes on any opt-out within 24 hours and never sells that number again. 7. Vendor shall indemnify Client against all claims arising from Vendor's leads. 9. Client may return a bad lead for credit within 10 days. Term ends 2027-06-30.
Data purchase terms. Buyer accepts leads as is. Vendor makes no warranty about consent. All sales final.
